'''Shield Securities''' was an organization active in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. They supplied [[Cam droid/Legends|cam droids]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planets]] [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]] and [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], as well as to many parts of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], such as the [[Bonchaka district|Bonchaka]], [[Neldiz district|Neldiz]], and [[F'tu district|F'tu]] manufacturing districts.

==History==
Shield Securities was a major company in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. Modified Sheild [[Security camera/Legends|security cameras]] were involved in the use of a [[Damotite bioweapon|bioweapon]] created by [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Lok Durd]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Because of the [[Bioweapon/Legends|bioweapon]] attack, the other areas of [[the galaxy]] were all suspects for the next attack's location, until the stores of [[damotite]] used in the creation of the weapon were destroyed on [[Lanteeb/Legends|Lanteeb]].<ref name="CWGsi" />
